payload.title: M3 Automation and insight: recurring drafts that need approval, publish-triggered alerts, delivery and engagement events
payload.description:
Outcome: recurring and event-driven newsletters with guardrails, and editors can see how issues perform.

Scope:
- Recurring cadence per newsletter (The Docket: every Friday): a recurring schedule assembles a draft from the period's published items a configurable time ahead and notifies admins. It never sends unattended: no admin approval, no issue.
- Triggered alerts on a publish event (Distinctive Mark precedential alerts by topic), connected to the publication's own Cyclotron and section classifiers. Admin-chosen policy per alert type; a republish, edit or reprojection never triggers a send.
- Events: SES delivery, bounce, complaint, open and click events to S3 (raw) with per-issue aggregates in DynamoDB; a custom click-tracking domain per site instead of awstrack.me; opens labelled as unreliable (Apple Mail Privacy Protection).
- Newsroom view of issue performance and list health; the site privacy policy covers tracking.

Done when: a Friday draft appears without anyone starting it and sends only after approval; publishing a precedential ruling produces an alert for subscribers to that topic exactly once; per-issue delivery, click and complaint figures are visible in the newsroom.
